payload.prompt: Direct implementation of requested artifact: Create a JSON schema file named POW_001_GENESIS_DATA_MODEL.json that serves as the concrete data model for the POW-001 Genesis Block archive. It must accurately reflect the canonical POW-001 constraints: exactly 21 blocks, physical placement matching digital positions 1-21, Bitcoin payment (499 EUR, 1 BTC confirmation), and fields for company name, logo/asset, TXID, reservation timestamp, and SHA-256 Genesis record hash. This model will be the foundation for the sponsor claim flow and permanent archive.
